summary: The authorized merge brings the completed Story 18.1 baseline into the Story 18.4 branch. This satisfies baseline availability only; Story 18.4's deferred prepared-source assumptions must now be reconciled by the plan owner and independently reviewed before tasks.

merge_authorization.scope: Merge pinned oct14/main into Stories 18.2 through 18.4 only; this is not planned-change or implementation approval.

contract_summary: Trusted composition supplies PreparedSourceGrantRequest with an application-held physical root and exact PreparedSourceApproval tuple.
PreparedSourceContextIssuer requires IPreparedSourceCurrentAuthorityVerifier and returns a bounded IPreparedSourceReadContext.
Current authority is rechecked through issuance and disclosure; revocation, change or unavailability fails closed and invalidates continuations.
PreparedSourceFunctions borrows one issued context and exposes exactly list_prepared_source, read_prepared_source and search_prepared_source with closed schemas.
Repository-relative results, cancellation, disposal, budgets and truthful limited or denied outcomes are part of the accepted boundary.

conflict_resolutions: docs/bmad/implementation-artifacts/sprint-status.yaml keeps Story 18.1 done and Story 18.4 in-progress.
docs/agents/project-state.md keeps current workflow and test policy, the completed integrated Story 18.1 baseline, and Story 18.4's plan-only reconciliation hold.
required_plan_reconciliation: Replace the deferred ID-I04 association with an explicit adapter to PreparedSourceApproval, PreparedSourceGrantRequest, PreparedSourceContextIssuer and IPreparedSourceCurrentAuthorityVerifier without exposing PhysicalRootPath or authority selectors to model arguments.

Define how the selected October batch, Repository membership, operator subject, Worker-source-read purpose, approval identity and root-binding identity populate and refresh the exact Story 18.1 approval tuple.

Define ownership and lifetime for the issued IPreparedSourceReadContext and PreparedSourceFunctions, including revocation, authority unavailability, cancellation, disposal and continuation invalidation.

Reconcile data-model cardinality and persistence so Story 18.4 stores only durable selection or opaque binding references and never treats a physical root, live context or continuation as durable authority.

Replace provisional ID-T04 wording with tests against the actual issuer, current-authority verifier and three-function contract, while preserving Story 18.1's DB-free direct qualification and avoiding duplicate source-access contracts.
Reassess FR-011, SC-006, implementation-design IDs and the planned-change trigger, then rerun deterministic plan validation and independent plan-only review before any task generation.
